pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro puriso pavāsaṃ gacchanto pajāpatiṃ etad avoca: suttaṃ dhārayitvā amukassa tantavāyassa dehi, cīvaraṃ vāyāpetvā nikkhipa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.4: assosi kho aññataro piṇḍacāriko bhikkhu tassa purisassa imaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.5: atha kho so bhikkhu yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ etad avoca: mahāpuñño 'si tvaṃ āvuso Upananda,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.6: amukasmiṃ okāse aññataro puriso pavāsaṃ gacchanto pajāpatiṃ etad avoca: suttaṃ . . . acchādessāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.8: so pi kho tantavāyo āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.9: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto yena so tantavāyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā tantavāyaṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.10: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ ca karohi vitthatañ ca appitañ ca suvītañ ca suppavāyitañ ca suvilekhitañ ca suvitacchitañ ca karohīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.11: ete kho me bhante suttaṃ dhārayitvā adaṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.13: na bhante sakkā āyataṃ vā vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā kātuṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.14: sakkā ca kho bhante suvītañ ca suppavāyitañ ca suvilekhitañ ca suvitacchitañ ca kātun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.15: iṅgha tvaṃ āvuso āyatañ ca karohi vitthatañ ca appitañ ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.17: atha kho so tantavāyo yathābhataṃ suttaṃ tante upanetvā yena sā itthi ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā taṃ itthiṃ etad avoca: suttena ayye attho 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.18: nanu tvaṃ ayyo mayā vutto iminā suttena cīvaraṃ vināhīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.19: saccāhaṃ ayye tayā vutto iminā suttena cīvaraṃ vināhīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.20: api ca maṃ ayyo Upanando evaṃ āha: iṅgha tvaṃ . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.22: atha kho sā itthi yatta kaṃ yeva suttaṃ paṭhamaṃ adāsi tattakaṃ pacchā adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.23: assosi kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto: so kira puriso pavāsato āgato 'ti. atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto yena tassa purisassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.24: atha kho so puriso yenāyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.25: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.26: vītaṃ taṃ cīvaran ti. ām' ayya vītaṃ taṃ cīvaran ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.28: atha kho sā itthi taṃ cīvaraṃ nīharitvā sāmikassa datvā etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.29: atha kho so puriso āyasmato Upanandassa Sakyaputtassa cīvaraṃ datvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.32: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyo Upanando mayā pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.33: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa purisassa . . . vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.34: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.35: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.36: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.37: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.41: aññātako moghapurisa aññātakassa na jānāti patirūpaṃ vā appatirūpaṃ vā santaṃ vā asantaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.42: tattha nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa pubbe appavārito aññātakassa gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.43: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.44: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.45.1: bhikkhuṃ pan' eva uddissa aññātako gahapati vā gahapatānī vā tantavāyehi cīvaraṃ vāyāpeyya. tatra ce so bhikkhu pubbe appavārito tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.46: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ ca karotha vitthatañ ca appitañ ca suvītañ ca suppavāyitañ ca suvilekhitañ ca suvitacchitañ ca karotha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.47: app eva nāma mayaṃ pi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:1.48: evañ ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattaṃ pi, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.2: atthāya bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā bhikkhuṃ acchādetukāmo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.4: mātito vā pitito vā yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā asambaddho.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.16: yaṃ bhikkhuṃ uddissa cīvaraṃ viyyati so bhikkhu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.18: pubbe avutto hoti: kīdisena te bhante cīvarena attho, kīdisaṃ te cīvaraṃ vāyāpemīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.22: idaṃ kho āvuso cīvaraṃ maṃ uddissa viyyati, āyatañ ca karotha vitthatañ ca
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.23: appitañ ca suvītañ ca suppavāyitañ ca suvilekhitañ ca suvitacchitañ ca karotha,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.24: app eva nāma mayaṃ pi āyasmantānaṃ kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyyāmā 'ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.25: evañ ca so bhikkhu vatvā kiñcimattaṃ anupadajjeyya antamaso piṇḍapātamattam pīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.27: yāgu pi bhattaṃ pi khādaniyaṃ pi cuṇṇapiṇḍo pi dantakaṭṭhaṃ pi dasikasuttaṃ pi antamaso dhammaṃ pi bhaṇati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.28: tassa vacanena āyataṃ vā vitthataṃ vā appitaṃ vā karoti, payoge dukkaṭaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.33: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ pubbe appavārito aññātakassa gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikapp aṃ āpannaṃ nissaggiyaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.38.1: aññātake aññātakasaññī pubbe appavārito gahapatikassa tantavāye upasaṃkamitvā cīvare vikappaṃ āpajjati, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.39: aññātake vematiko pubbe . . . āpajjati, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np27:2.40: aññātake ñātakasaññī pubbe . . . āpajjati, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
